what: Identity pin for the vendored contract-lint trio, taken before the structure pass moved anything.
why: lint-parity.test.js is the only gate holding the vm canonical and the sdk copy byte-identical: there is no sync script. A rename that re-vendors the trio must reproduce these digests under the new names, or the two linters have drifted.
note: Declared, not graded: no tool, test or script in this repo reads this file, so a stale path or digest here fails nothing; the live parity gate is test/unit/lint_parity.test.js, which builds the sdk path itself. Every key, digest and sdkPath below is the AT1 record, unchanged; sdkPathAtOrigin records the sdk's spelling of the same file after its snake_case rename.
